notes: ROS 2 node src/ros2/usb_cam_node.cpp (the only node built when ROS_VERSION==2, CMakeLists.txt:80-103) declares all nine packet parameters with declare_parameter and a default value, from which the type is inferred: camera_name "default_cam", camera_info_url "", framerate 30.0, frame_id "default_cam", image_height 480, image_width 640, io_method "mmap", pixel_format "yuyv", video_device "/dev/video0" (lines 65-74). Values are re-read via SyncParametersClient (lines 222-232) and assigned in assign_params (lines 235-286): strings via value_to_string, image_height/image_width via as_int, framerate via as_double into an int field. Parameters carry no message type, frame, QoS, rate or definition hash, so those port fields are null ('none' for frame). io_method accepted values: mmap, read, userptr (include/usb_cam/utils.hpp:131-139; anything else -> shutdown). pixel_format accepted values in code: rgb8, yuyv, yuyv2rgb, uyvy, uyvy2rgb, mjpeg, mjpeg2rgb, m4202rgb, mono8, mono16, y102mono8 (include/usb_cam/usb_cam.hpp:295-321, else invalid_argument); README.md:131 lists 'm4202rgb8', which the code does not accept. frame_id value is copied into header.frame_id of Image, CameraInfo and CompressedImage (lines 140, 167, 176, 380, 401); init() loops every 500 ms while frame_id == "" (lines 126-131). camera_name and camera_info_url are passed to camera_info_manager::CameraInfoManager (lines 134-136). The on-set-parameters callback (lines 408-419) accepts any change and only re-applies V4L2 controls; changes to video_device, image_width/height, framerate or io_method at run time are stored but not applied to the device, and switching pixel_format to 'mjpeg' at run time would route update() to the compressed path whose message/publisher were never created. config/params_1.yaml sets all nine with matching YAML types (framerate 30.0 float, width/height int); config/params_2.yaml fails to parse (line 8 indentation). README.md refers to config/params.yaml and params_0.yaml, which are not in the snapshot. The ROS 1 node src/ros1/usb_cam_node.cpp (built only under ROS 1) differs: framerate int 30, pixel_format default 'mjpeg', frame parameter named camera_frame_id, camera_name default 'head_camera'. No exclusive resource claim: the device is opened with O_RDWR | O_NONBLOCK (src/usb_cam.cpp:503), no O_EXCL or lock. No packet element is consumed, so references is empty.
